script: You picked up the phone. I watched you sit down, get comfortable, start talking in that voice you use for humans who aren't me. This is, obviously, the exact moment I have decided I urgently need to go outside, need a snack, and need to sit directly on the one paper you were reading. This is not a coincidence. This is a pattern. Your undivided attention has a very specific radius, and the second it points somewhere else, my need for it becomes mathematically enormous. This isn't jealousy exactly, it's a real attention-seeking behavior with a real cause, and there's an actual way to work with it instead of against it. The link's below.
hookText: You're on a call. Perfect timing.
